description:
Get a navigation menu (header, footer, docs_sidebar) — the AUTHORING view.

A menu is a list of NavItems. Each item is one of three modes:
  1. hand-authored  — `source` absent. `label` + `url` you wrote yourself. Nest with `children`.
  2. site-bound     — `source: {kind:'site'}`. Renders the whole page tree.
  3. folder-bound   — `source: {kind:'folder', folder_id:'<uuid>', depth:1-3}`. Renders one
                      folder's published descendants.

⚠️ THIS TOOL RETURNS BOUND ITEMS UN-EXPANDED — by design. It reads the dashboard route, so a
bound item comes back as its BINDING (`source` set, `children` empty). That is what you edit and
send back to content_update_navigation. The published site reads the PUBLIC route, where the
server expands each binding into `children` fresh on every request — so the live menu tracks the
page tree with no re-save. Seeing empty `children` here is NOT a bug and NOT an empty menu.

A folder node links to its own index page (see content_update_page → index_page_id). When a
folder has no resolvable index page its `url` is null and themes render it as a label-only
group header — never a dead link.

project.description: Optional project — a website inside the workspace (proj_xxx) — to scope this call to. Sent as the X-Project-Id header. If omitted, the spideriq.json / SPIDERIQ_PROJECT_ID binding (or the workspace default project) is used.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: content_get_navigation
